prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Find, grab, check properties, and do your specific task if object is approached, otherwise approach it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = DoSpecificTask    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = MoveRobot    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
